description.subtitle: Nike first-team shirt from Inter 2025 2026 player version - blue and black
description.tagline: Maximum demand for the most faithful fans
description.intro: The Match Nike Inter 2025/2026 is the same shirt that players wear on the field. Designed to deliver professional performance, it combines advanced technology with an aesthetic that pays tribute to the club’s history. Ideal for those who seek the best in every detail.
key_benefits: Elite performance: Same shirt that players wear in official match.
Extreme lightness: Ultralight technical fabric that promotes mobility.
Comodidad inteligente: Materiales que expulsan el sudor y mantienen la frescura.
Authentic design: Official details and shield of the thermo-applied Inter.
Ideal para el partido: Pensada para un uso exigente durante el juego.
